question:
Select the option that related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

PG ∶ VM ∶∶ AB ∶ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (6) is added to each position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• PG ∶ VM 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f10dda86611aa310d0df45bb449f50ec9fa68b47b15fe3f2959d1fe066755b6a.png] 

Similarly,

 
• AB ∶ ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90947141d9fd37273eaaf73945321302f9f1c1dbe76760ce6707df9b09a8c9b5.png] 

Hence, "GH" is the correct answer.

9e:T
